purpose: Read-only source discovery and bounded service validation; no runtime or global changes.
assessment: Cartagena’s official catastro portal identifies AMB Catastro as gestor catastral for Cartagena under a 2024 contract and links the public Geoportal. This verifies city-local cadastral management. The official Geoportal client declares a public terrenos vector-layer request, but its bounded bbox route contains no field-selection parameter and no public schema/OpenAPI defines the response properties. The client reads `id` as a selection key, but its native cadastral meaning and returned-property contract are unknown. Since parcel details/search can expose addresses and references, no feature request or geometry was made. This is a public vector candidate, not a verified safe parcel geometry source.

officialEvidence.observation: Official City Catastro portal identifies AMB Catastro as Cartagena gestor catastral and links to the public Geoportal.
Public Geoportal Cartagena shell; frontend exposes candidate vector layer names and bbox API pattern.

Frontend JavaScript declares terrenos, unidades, construcciones, barrios and vias layer routes, requests api/capas/{name}?bbox=..., and uses terrain feature id for details; no parcel property schema was established.
Public service health response names katastermap-prod.
Malformed-bbox validation response was an empty application/json FeatureCollection with no schema; no feature query was made.
Local fetch access denied; this does not establish origin availability or failure and was not treated as provider downtime.
Official AMB Catastro Cartagena homepage links to the Geoportal and identifies AMB as the gestor catastral contracted by the district for conservation and diffusion of the cadastral service.
Official City notice (2025-07-14) describes the public Geoportal as an interactive map to visualize, consult and analyze cadastral/geospatial information.

Official Planning Department page describes MIDAS as free-access and says updated cadastral information generated by AMB is visualized there, with user-facing data downloads. MIDAS is a separate system; no feature schema or downloadable parcel data was requested during this review.

observedRoutes: GET /geoportal-cartagena/api/capas/{layer}?bbox={west,south,east,north}; frontend provides EPSG:4326 extent to six decimals, with no field selection.
Frontend selection reads feature property `id`; this is not documented as the native cadastral identifier. Detail/search routes that can return parcel references and addresses were not queried.
serviceTrace.notes: Official public Geoportal landing page and app bundle inspected. The frontend builds `GET api/capas/{name}?bbox={bounds}` with extent transformed to EPSG:4326 and six decimal places; it requests no `fields`/`outFields` allowlist. The map reads `feature.properties.id` for selection, but neither native cadastral identity nor a property-minimal response is documented. The client also exposes property lookup/detail routes showing cadastral reference, parcel number and address, which were not queried. No official OpenAPI/schema or safe geometry-only attribute contract was located; no feature request or geometry retained.

geometryValidation.reason: No official OpenAPI or explicit geometry-only/identifier-only response allowlist was found. The frontend bbox route has no field selection, so no feature query was made.
